text_block_list.text:
After our outing.
At Cesario's request, I chaperoned her
and her friends to—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
The sea~♪
And the sun is so nice and warm~!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
There won't be any sharks... probably,
but I hope we have some exciting encounters♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
thank you very much for chaperoning us today.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"So... if you'd like,
would you care to join in the fun, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: Is it really okay for an adult like me to join in?
Is it really okay for an adult like me to join in?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, you're more than welcome!♪
Let's have fun to our hearts' content!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I've compiled all the featured spots,
so I'll transfer them to your phone, Trainer~.
choice_data_list: Oh, you're really fired up.
Wow, you're really fired up!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's precisely because of opportunities like this
that there's so much to gain♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Over here, over here!
There's a cave with a really interesting shape over that way~♪
choice_data_list: W-Wait... run a little slower!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ah, sorry about that! The scenery isn't going anywhere, so let's head over slowly.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wait! That creepy, squirming figure...
Isn't that a zombie?!"
choice_data_list: Yes, really!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fuehh... Help meee~.
The kelp's tangled all around me and won't come off~.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Pfft.
Craft! Wait up, I'm heading over!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho, heave-ho...
Hehe, the sea breeze feels so nice♪

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Water cycling... is truly fun.
I'm glad I took the plunge and tried it.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely♪ ...All right,
let's keep on going just like this!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, gather 'round everyone~
Trainer, you too!
Please squeeze in closer to Cesario~

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: —Say cheese♪

And with that, Cesario and the others let out their inner child
and thoroughly enjoyed the sea.
Seeing Cesario from up close, she shows so many innocent expressions—it feels quite refreshing.
choice_data_list: ...I'm glad I came.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Everyone is fast asleep, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It really turned into a wonderful memory.
It might have been a while since I laughed that much♪
choice_data_list: I had fun too, and besides—
I had fun too, and besides—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
choice_data_list: I'm relieved to see you're not worrying about it anymore.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I want to stand as an equal with the "Teachers"
I so respect as soon as possible... and yet.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "I haven't the slightest clue how I might draw closer to it..."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's true.
I suppose you could say I've found closure within myself.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I've decided. I won't rush, and I'll cherish the present. I'll gain plenty of experience and become an adult I can be proud of in the future.
choice_data_list: I see... Sounds good to me.

text_block_list.text:
However, why was I invited to hang out too?
I voiced the question I had been wondering all along.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
That is... because you are my partner.
choice_data_list: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I thought that if I'm going to enjoy this moment,
I want you by my side.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Once again, thank you.
For going along with my selfishness.
choice_data_list: If that's the case, I'll join you anytime!
Because making children's wishes come true is what adults do.
I don't think you're being selfish at all.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "Please continue to stay by my side and build more memories together with me."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Until I become an adult, and even after I do,
for a long, long time to come――
choice_data_list: Of course. After all, I'm your partner.
Of course, I'm your partner after all.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yes...!
—Achoo!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Craft, cut it out!
You're going to blow our cover!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Rather than "might get found out"... it feels like I've already been found out.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
How long have you all been... Hey!
It's way too late to pretend you're asleep—

Cesario and the others carried on noisily. This, too,
would surely become another fond memory.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Mmh... Acting like a grown-up again, are we?
choice_data_list: Because I'm an adult.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, giggle!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Geez... In the future, when my students come to me with worries,
I'm totally gonna act like a know-it-all adult too, just so you know.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
And so, just like you—
I hope I can show them the way, too.
choice_data_list: I'm sure you can do it.
I'm sure you can do it.

text_block_list.text: —Achoo!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Craft, cut it out!
You're going to blow our cover!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Rather than "might get found out"... it feels like I've already been found out.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
How long have you all been... Hey!
It's way too late to pretend you're asleep—

Cesario and the others carried on noisily. This, too,
would surely become another fond memory.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?
choice_data_list: If anything, I'd rather you be more selfish with me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, that is difficult... Most matters
are things I can easily handle on my own—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, then will you come to the beach with me again?
I want to hang out with everyone, just like today.
choice_data_list: Sure, let's make lots of memories together!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Fufu... I'm looking forward to it♪
—Achoo!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Craft, cut it out!
You're going to blow our cover!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Rather than "might get found out"... it feels like I've already been found out.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
How long have you all been... Hey!
It's way too late to pretend you're asleep—

Cesario and the others carried on noisily. This, too,
would surely become another fond memory.
